d: Mercedes faced one of the biggest decisions in its recent history when Lewis Hamilton announced his move to Ferrari. Replacing a seven-time world champion was never going to be easy. But the team turned to an 18-year-old Italian, Kimi Antonelli, a talent it had identified and nurtured from a very young age. What made Mercedes so confident that he was ready for Formula One's biggest stage? And can Antonelli handle the pressure of stepping into Hamilton's seat while carving out an identity of his own? Rupha Ramani looks at the making of Mercedes' teenage prodigy and the enormous expectations…
